label: NZEUG regional conferences reach Auckland and Christchurch
summary: NZEUG's 2025 reports describe regional user conferences at AUT in Auckland and in Christchurch, with practitioner talks, student involvement, volunteer organisers and assistance from Eagle Technology and commercial sponsors.
